evidence: Carries the P2P label and replaces legacy private broadcast networking in net.cpp and net_processing.cpp with isolated P2P broadcast jobs over Tor SOCKS5.
rationale: Addresses critical transaction origin privacy leaks in the existing private broadcast implementation, which reviewers describe as an active footgun due to correlation leaks with clearnet node state. The rewrite completely isolates broadcast attempts from CConnman and PeerManager to eliminate peer manipulation and timing attacks.
